how.title: Five easy steps
how.s1d: Scan the QR code on your table with your phone camera.
how.s2d: Add dishes and notes like less spicy. Place your order.
how.s3d: Your waiter confirms the order with you and tells the chef.
how.s4d: Hot food arrives at your table. Order another round any time.
how.s5d: Pay at the counter by cash, UPI or card. No online payment.
